answer: The quill register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and lantern seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 25 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 25 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
